ops.body: Independent scheduler review FAIL at b55d73abfb027edc72c3ddb581171f2558b014f3; report /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/reviews/scheduler.json. Stop only closes s.stop; synchronous Inventory.Scan blocks the event loop, and its context cancellation happens only later in drain. Repro with Scan waiting on ctx.Done confirms Stop hangs until parent independently cancels. Fix Stop cancellation independently of loop, test initial/periodic scan. Existing race suite and repeated priority/concurrency/code-only tests pass. Also scope clarification after reading D15 review: finding #1 is specifically upgrading a cache written by old unshipped commit76e7ece. We do not need compatibility/migrations for unreleased intermediate caches; a clean v1 cache format/version can invalidate development data. Keep actual same-final-version attribute-change classification correctness, but don't build backwards compatibility solely for intermediate builds. Other D15 findings are concrete; merge overlap with main fixes rather than duplicating.
